_readme: Remote bestiary / Critter Safari rules. Every FamilyAddons client (26.1.2 and 26.2) fetches this
file on join and every 10 minutes, so a mob that turns out not to be highlighted can be added
here for everyone without shipping an update. Same format as config/familyaddons/custom_bestiary.json.
Top-level keys are zone keys (safari, crimson_isle, catacombs, ...); keys starting with _ are ignored.
Per mob: name (required, exact in-game name); for mobs WITHOUT a readable nametag add
entityType (vanilla id, e.g. bat), optional minWidth/maxWidth (bounding box), optional variants
Get those values in game with /fa entitydump while standing next to the mob.
optional needsLabel (true = also require a name stand carrying the mob's name within a few blocks; tells a Gazer from a fairy soul).
A remote entry with the same name as a NEU repo mob replaces it; the user's own custom_bestiary.json
still overrides this file. Push to master and clients pick it up within 10 minutes.
